title: Research Associate Required – PSF-Funded Research Project at AWKUM, Department of Agronomy
text:
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

Department of Agronomy

CAREER OPPORTUNITY

Position Vacant

Research Associate | PSF-Funded Research Project

Applications are invited from qualified, motivated and
research-oriented candidates for one position of Research
Associate under a research project funded by the Pakistan
Science Foundation (PSF), being executed at the Department
of Agronomy, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM).

Research Project Title

Genotype Authentication, Molecular Profiling and
Phenological Assessment of Olive Varieties and Their
Pollinizers for Developing a Climate-Resilient Production Package

Position

Research Associate

Vacancies

01 Position

Monthly Salary

PKR 25,000/-

Project Duration

Three Years

Place of Placement

Department of Agronomy, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan,
and Institute of Biotechnology and Genetic Engineering,
The University of Agriculture Peshawar.

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must possess one of the following qualifications
from an HEC-recognized university:

M.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture in Agronomy

M.Phil. Biotechnology

M.Phil. Bioinformatics

Preference will be given to candidates having relevant
research experience, particularly in molecular biology,
DNA-based techniques, bioinformatics, plant genetic
characterization, phenological studies and data analysis.

Key Responsibilities

Assisting in project activities related to olive germplasm
characterization and genotype authentication.

Conducting molecular profiling and genetic characterization
of olive varieties and their pollinizers.

Recording and monitoring phenological traits of olive varieties.

Assisting in field experiments, laboratory analyses
and data collection.

Processing and analyzing experimental and molecular data.

Preparing technical reports, research documentation
and scientific publications.

Performing other research-related activities assigned
by the Principal Investigator.

Application Procedure

Interested and eligible candidates are required to submit
their applications along with the following documents to
the Principal Investigator:

Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV).

Copies of academic credentials.

Copy of CNIC.

Relevant experience certificates.

Important Dates

Application Deadline

27

November 2026

Friday

Interview Date

30

November 2026

Monday

Applications Should Be Submitted To

Prof. Dr. Aqib Iqbal

Principal Investigator (PI)

Department of Agronomy

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM)

Important:

Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview.
No TA/DA will be admissible for the interview. The position
is purely project-based and will remain subject to the terms
and conditions of the PSF-funded project.

ABDUL WALI KHAN UNIVERSITY MARDAN
